rows.speaker: علي بن أبي طالب
rows.claim: ʿAlī reports that the Prophet said each person's place in Paradise or Hell is recorded; when asked whether to rely on this, he said to act, since each is facilitated, then recited al-Layl 92:5–10.
rows.anchor: عن علي بن أبي طالب عن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم أنه كان في جنازة فأخذ عودا ينكت في الأرض

rows.speaker: النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم
rows.claim: The Prophet recounts the first revelation: Gabriel pressed him three times, then recited 96:1–5; Khadīja comforted him and Waraqa identified the revelation as that given to Moses and predicted hostility, and Gabriel later reassured him after revelation paused.
rows.anchor: ثم أرسلني فقال: {اقرأ باسم ربك الذي خلق} حتى بلغ {ما لم يعلم}
